format.description: '16:9' '1080p' '9:16' '1:1' '4:5' (aliases landscape vertical square portrait) — or w/h

beats.description: explicit beat times or a `vk analyze` JSON path

music.description: music file (mixed at render, ducked under voice)

voice.description: TTS config {manifest, voice, rate, lead, tail, cast:{who:{voice}}}

cover.description: defaults for cover transitions {colors, n, axis}

fadeOut.description: fade the last scene to black over N seconds

seed.description: seed of Math.random in setup code

strict.description: unknown names throw (with did-you-mean); Math.random() during a frame throws. CLI vk peek/qa/render turn it on by default

draft.description: draft preview quality (lower 3D res/AA, no DOF/bloom); vk peek/render --draft set it

bg.description: 'dark' | 'light' | 'accent' (palette mode) | CSS colour | {type:'mesh'|'grid'|…} | array of layers

transition.description: entrance transition 'name:seconds' or {type, d, ease, focal:{x,y}}

camera.description: camera keys [{t, x, y, s, r, ease}]

cameraHold.description: omitted camera keys keep the previous value

shots.description: shot list [{t, shot:"medium", on: subject, punch, pan, dolly}]

vo.description: voice-over text (run `vk tts page.html`); arrays = several lines / speakers

hold.description: extra seconds after the last animation when dur is "auto"

snap.description: 'beat' | 'bar' | 'b:2' — extend the cut to the grid

at.description: entrance time (scene-local s, "b:8" beat, "+0.3" after the previous element; default: cascade)

fx.description: entrance effect name(s), space-combinable ('up blur'); false = none

d.description: entrance duration (s); default depends on the fx

out.description: exit time (scene-local s); exit uses outFx (default: the entrance fx reversed)

sfx.description: sound played at the entrance (a sounds name)

size.description: font size: number = px at 720p (auto-scaled) or a theme step 'h1' 'h2' 'body' …

color.description: text colour (CSS) or a palette name (accent, fg, muted …)

w.description: width: ≤1 = fraction of the frame, >1 = px

pos.description: absolute position {x, y, right, bottom, anchor:"center"|"tl"…}; leaves the centred flow

fixed.description: not affected by the scene camera

class.description: extra CSS class (vk-bleed = allowed outside the safe area)

on.description: per-frame hook on(el, local, p, t) — must depend on time only

beat.description: beat pulse {scale, brightness, unit:"beat"|"bar", k, beats:[…]}

toon.doc: quantise luminance into flat bands (keeps hue); shadowTint colours the darkest band

palette.doc: map to a colour set: mode 'ramp' (luminance through colours, dark → light) or 'nearest'

ink.doc: sumi ink: desaturate toward an ink ramp, lift whites to paper, keep some colour (sat), crush blacks

outline.doc: object outlines from depth + normal discontinuities (and colour if color edges on); boil = redraw rate (fps) of the wobble

edges.doc: neon/blueprint edges: edge lines coloured by the image (or color) over a darkened background

kuwahara.doc: painterly Kuwahara smoothing (flat strokes, kept edges); radius ≤ 8 px

paper.doc: paper / watercolour wash: fibre texture, granulation, edge darkening (pigment pooling), wet bleed; opaque composites over the paper colour

halftone.doc: print dots: mode 'mono' | 'cmyk' | 'color'; size = cell px

pixel.doc: pixel art: block size px, optional palette / level count with ordered (Bayer) dithering

glow.doc: soft glow of bright areas (display-space, after the look; the HDR bloom happens earlier)

tiltshift.doc: miniature lens: blur outside a horizontal focus band (+ saturation boost)

mist.doc: depth mist toward a colour (ink-wash distance, aerial perspective); sky = fill empty pixels too

hatch.doc: pen hatching in the dark tones (1–3 directions by darkness)

entries.name: crayon
entries.description: 蜡笔绘本 · Crayon picture book — 蜡笔绘本：暖白画纸纹理、蜡质颗粒与透出的纸纹、抖动描边（每秒 8 次线条沸腾）、粉彩山丘与大太阳，站酷快乐体手写标题，卡林巴与马林巴。
qa: paper tooth visible inside every fill (wax texture)
outlines boil but shapes stay recognisable (≤ 4 px wobble)
pastel palette, no pure black
hand-lettered font for all on-screen text
faces big enough to read expressions
entries.api: const S = v.style; S.world(sc, "mountain dusk pine") · S.character(W.actors, {look}) · S.title(sc, text, {sub}) · S.effect(sc, "signature", {at,x,y}) · S.transition("default"|"soft"|"strong") · S.sfx(sc, kind, t) · S.music(v) · S.qa (checklist)

entries.name: ink
entries.description: 水墨 · Ink wash — 宣纸水墨：远山淡墨晕染、近景浓墨勾勒、留白与雾带，朱砂印章、竖排毛笔题字，古琴与竹笛。
qa: generous empty paper (留白): at least a third of the frame is plain paper
far layers lighter and softer than near layers (aerial perspective)
only one saturated accent (seal red)
brush outlines wobble; nothing looks vector-perfect
titles vertical, top-right or top-left, never centred over the subject
entries.api: const S = v.style; S.world(sc, "mountain dusk pine") · S.character(W.actors, {look}) · S.title(sc, text, {sub}) · S.effect(sc, "signature", {at,x,y}) · S.transition("default"|"soft"|"strong") · S.sfx(sc, kind, t) · S.music(v) · S.qa (checklist)

entries.name: neon
entries.description: 赛博霓虹 · Cyber neon — 赛博霓虹：雨夜都市剪影、发光线描人物、霓虹招牌标题（vk.gl 辉光 bloom）、CRT 扫描线与色散，合成器琶音。
qa: glows are coloured, never pure white blobs (bloom knee)
scanlines subtle (< 10 % darkening)
two neon hues + one accent max
contours continuous (no broken neon tubes on characters)
text legible through the glitch transition

entries.name: opera
entries.description: 重彩装饰 · Decorative opera colour (Havoc in Heaven) — 《大闹天宫》式重彩装饰：石青石绿与朱红金黄的饱和平涂、粗墨线、描金纹样、层叠祥云与天宫殿宇，匾额题字，京剧锣鼓。
qa: every shape has the dark contour
palette limited to 石青 / 石绿 / 朱红 / 金 / cream
clouds are scrolled 祥云 with curls, not fluffy blobs
symmetric, frontal staging for titles
gold ornaments do not cover faces

entries.name: papercut
entries.description: 剪纸 · Paper-cut (Shanghai Animation Film Studio) — 上美厂剪纸片：彩纸层层叠贴，剪刀毛边、镂空纹样、纸片投影，宣纸底色，锣鼓点配乐。
qa: edges show scissor wobble (no perfectly smooth vectors)
every character piece has the lifted paper shadow
no gradients on character pieces (flat paper colour only)
joints overlap (no gaps between cut pieces when limbs bend)
rice-paper grain visible on the background
red seal/banner contrast readable over the background

qa: every frame uses only the 16 palette colours (plus pixel-filter mixes)
pixel grid fixed to the screen (filter on the whole scene, not per object)
text ≥ 3 'pixels' thick after pixelation
no smooth zooms (punch = shake)
outline on every character piece

entries.api: const S = v.style; S.world(sc, "mountain dusk pine") · S.character(W.actors, {look}) · S.title(sc, text, {sub}) · S.effect(sc, "signature", {at,x,y}) · S.transition("default"|"soft"|"strong") · S.sfx(sc, kind, t) · S.music(v) · S.qa (checklist)

entries.name: diorama
entries.description: stylised diorama module: kind 'papercut' (layered cut-paper shadow box) | 'popup' (pop-up book: hinged flats rise as the book opens, page turns) | 'isometric' (low-poly island on a plinth, ortho camera) | 'tiltshift' (miniature)

palette.description: dusk dawn forest sea ink candy mono or [colours] (back = last)

layers.description: papercut: count or [{shape, height, color, z, props, rise}]

rise.description: papercut layers rise in: {t, d, stagger, order}

pieces.description: popup: [{shape, x, z, height, color, at}] hinged flats

entries.example: sc.three(vk.three.diorama({ kind: 'papercut', layers: 6, sun: true, rise: { t: 0, stagger: .12 } }), { camera: vk.three.rig.orbit({ target: [0, 0, -1], radius: 10, from: -6, to: 6, dur: 6 }), post: { look: 'papercut' } })

entries.name: globe
entries.description: globe module: Natural Earth land (vendored, public domain) or procedural texture, graticule, atmosphere rim, markers that pop in, great-circle arcs that draw on
entries.example: sc.three(vk.three.globe({ markers: [{ lat: 31.2, lon: 121.5 }], arcs: [{ from: [31.2, 121.5], to: [51.5, -.1], t: 1 }] }), { camera: { pos: [0, 0, 5], target: [0, 0, 0] } })

entries.name: layer
entries.description: sc.three(setup, update, opts) / sc.three(modules, opts): a three.js scene composited into the layer stack (scene layers sit behind text unless z:"front")

camera.description: rig t → {pos, target, fov, roll} or a fixed state

look.description: NPR look chain (see three/look); same as post.look

key.description: lt => string: skip re-render while unchanged

entries.example: sc.three(({ THREE, scene }) => { const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusKnotGeometry(.6, .2, 128, 16), vk.three.materials.chrome()); scene.add(m); return t => { m.rotation.y = t * .8; }; }, { camera: { pos: [0, 0, 4], target: [0, 0, 0] } })

entries.name: look
entries.description: NPR look chain after the composite (post.look or layer opt look): preset name, pass list, or {preset, <pass>: {…}|false}. Presets: ink watercolor papercut pixel neon comic blueprint sketch miniature. Passes: toon posterize palette ink outline edges kuwahara paper halftone pixel glow tiltshift mist hatch (vk.three.look.passes for params)

passes.description: [{type, …params}] in order (params may be t => value)

<pass>.description: |override (or drop) one pass of the preset, e.g. outline: {width: 2}

entries.example: sc.three(vk.three.terrain({ type: 'mountains' }), { post: { look: { preset: 'ink', mist: { density: .6 } } } })

entries.name: mixer
entries.description: time-driven AnimationMixer: const m = vk.three.mixer(root, clips[, {timeline}]) in setup; m.at(t) in update (never mixer.update(dt)); timeline cross-fades clips as a pure function of t

timeline.description: [{t, clip, fade:.3, speed:1, loop:true, offset, weight}]

entries.example: const m = vk.three.mixer(gltf.scene, gltf.animations); return t => m.at(t);

entries.name: model
entries.description: glTF/GLB as a scene module: loads (Draco/meshopt), normalises to size, feet on y=0, mixer timeline animation (pure in t), shadows, auto lights, ground disc, spin

center.description: centre vertically instead of feet on ground

timeline.description: [{t, clip, fade, speed, loop, offset, weight}] cross-faded clips

lights.description: auto lights when the scene has none

entries.example: sc.three(vk.three.model('assets/models/robot.glb', { size: 2, timeline: [{ t: 0, clip: 'Idle' }, { t: 2, clip: 'Walking', fade: .4 }] }), { env: 'studio' })

entries.name: particles
entries.description: 50k–200k GPU particles morphing between targets (vertex-shader, pure function of t)

beat.description: {amp, k, every} pulse on the video beat grid

entries.example: sc.three(vk.three.particles({ n: 80000, targets: { g: 'galaxy', logo: { text: 'vidkit', font: '900 220px Archivo' } }, morph: [{ t: 0, to: 'g' }, { t: 2, to: 'logo', d: 2, style: 'converge' }] }), { camera: { pos: [0, 0, 8], target: [0, 0, 0] } })

entries.name: post
entries.description: post stack (every value may be t => value)

bloom.description: {strength:.55, threshold:1, knee:.6, radius:1, clamp:40}; false = off (draft: off)

grade.description: 'teal-orange' 'cool' 'warm' 'bleach' 'mono' 'cyber' or {temperature, tint, lift, gamma, gain, contrast, saturation}

look.description: NPR look chain after the composite (see three/look)

entries.example: { post: { bloom: { strength: .4 }, grade: 'cool', dof: { aperture: 4 } } }

entries.name: shaderPlate
entries.description: fullscreen raymarch / SDF / GLSL plate rendered into the HDR scene buffer (so AA jitter, motion-blur sub-frames, bloom, grade and looks apply); camera rays follow the vk.three camera rig

sdf.description: GLSL defining float map(vec3 p) (helpers: sdSphere sdBox sdTorus opSU rot2 fbm pal calcAO …)

shade.description: GLSL vec3 shade(vec3 p, vec3 n, vec3 rd, float t)

glsl.description: raw mode: vec4 image(vec2 uv, vec3 ro, vec3 rd)

depth.description: write gl_FragDepth so meshes intersect the plate

entries.example: sc.three(vk.three.shaderPlate({ preset: 'metaballs' }), { camera: vk.three.rig.orbit({ radius: 5, dur: 6 }), post: { bloom: { strength: .6 } } })

entries.name: shapes
entries.description: pure 2D silhouette generators → THREE.Shape (ridge hills mountains waves forest city pine tree house pagoda cloud circle crescent star bird boat grass rect path): vk.three.shapes.of(spec) for dioramas, extrusions and paper cut-outs

entries.name: sim
entries.description: fixed-dt simulation with exact state snapshots every N steps → seekable at(t), so parallel render workers agree bit-for-bit (snapshots shared through the vk disk cache)

init.description: rand => state (numbers + typed arrays; rand is seeded, init only)

step.description: (state, dt, t, i) => void — mutate state; pure in (state, i)

key.description: extra cache key (bump when captured constants change)

entries.example: const s = vk.three.sim({ duration: 8, init: () => ({ y: 2, v: 0 }), step: (S, dt) => { S.v -= 9.8 * dt; S.y += S.v * dt; if (S.y < 0) { S.y = 0; S.v *= -.8; } } }); // setup: await s.ready(ctx); update: t => s.at(t).y

entries.name: studioScene
entries.description: procedural studio light scene (for PMREM or as a backdrop)

entries.name: terrain
entries.description: heightmap terrain module (procedural fbm/hills/mountains/ridged/island/mesa/dunes, a function, or an image heightmap) with colour ramps, slope rock, snow, strata block, water, contour lines and instanced scatter (pine/tree/rock/house) that can grow in

type.description: fbm hills mountains ridged island mesa dunes flat | (x, z) => 0..1

colors.description: alpine island desert ink paper lava mono or [[h, colour], …]

scatter.description: [{shape, n, minH, maxH, maxSlope, scale, grow:{t, d}}]

entries.example: sc.three(vk.three.terrain({ type: 'mountains', colors: 'ink', scatter: [{ shape: 'pine', n: 300, maxH: .5 }] }), { camera: vk.three.rig.orbit({ radius: 12, height: 5, dur: 8 }) })

entries.name: text3d
entries.description: extruded, bevelled 3D text with per-letter in/out animation (pure in t); bundled fonts archivo-black anton instrument-serif, or any typeface JSON (vk font3d)

font.description: font id or typeface JSON url

material.description: three material name / THREE.Material / {color, roughness, metalness}

in.description: rise drop flip scale spin swing type pop, or {preset, t, d, stagger, order, ease}

animate.description: (letter, i, t, info) custom per-letter motion

entries.example: sc.three(vk.three.text3d({ text: 'HELLO', material: 'gold', in: { preset: 'rise', stagger: .06 } }), { camera: { pos: [0, 0, 6], target: [0, 0, 0] }, env: 'studio' })

entries.name: turntable
entries.description: product turntable: studio env (PMREM), cyclorama, glossy floor + reflection, contact shadow, strip-light sweeps, DOF autofocus

model.description: GLB url or loaded gltf (auto-scaled to height)

sweeps.description: [{t, d, from, to, color, radius}] strip-light sweeps

sweep.description: periodic sweep {every, t, d, color}; null = off

material.description: three material name (see three.materials) or a THREE.Material

entries.example: sc.three(vk.three.turntable({ product: 'earbuds', spin: 18, sweeps: [{ t: 1, d: 1.4 }] }), { camera: vk.three.rig.orbit({ radius: 5, dur: 5 }) })

entries.name: fly
entries.description: centripetal Catmull-Rom flythrough at constant speed
